title: Sertorius
summary: Raleigh names Sertorius in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Sertorius the Roman, who Plutarke saith found a great bodie in Lybia where Hercules slew Antaeus. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIII, §. V, sig. 268a–268b
